content.json:
## Altiward overview
Who holds admin rights on your Macs, how elevations went over the period, and what needs a look, from the events Altiward sends to the `AltiwardOCSF_CL` table. The same figures are on the Altiward console's Overview.

**Without a grant** means admin rights that nobody granted through SAP Privileges: someone was added to the admin group directly, or an account was created as an admin.

### Now
From the last 90 days of events, whatever the period.

content.query:
let Sessions = AltiwardOCSF_CL
| where isnotempty(SessionUid)
| extend Ev = tostring(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.event_type)
| where Ev in ("elevation.granted", "admin.out_of_band", "elevation.revoked", "elevation.expired_enforced", "admin.out_of_band_removed")
| extend IsStart = Ev in ("elevation.granted", "admin.out_of_band"), Src = tostring(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.source),
    Exp = unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(tolong(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.expires_time)), Email = tostring(Ocsf.user.email_addr)
| summarize Started = minif(TimeGenerated, IsStart), Ended = maxif(TimeGenerated, not(IsStart)),
    Expires = maxif(Exp, Ev == "elevation.granted"), Src = take_anyif(Src, IsStart and isnotempty(Src)),
    Email = take_anyif(Email, isnotempty(Email)), UserName = take_anyif(UserName, isnotempty(UserName)),
    DeviceSerial = take_any(DeviceSerial) by SessionUid
| where isnotnull(Started)
| extend Source = case(Src == "privileges", "Privileges", Src == "out_of_band", "Without a grant", ""),
    Person = iff(isnotempty(Email), Email, strcat(UserName, " on ", DeviceSerial));
Sessions
| where isnull(Ended)
| summarize People = count() by Source
| union (datatable(Source: string, People: long)["Privileges", 0, "Without a grant", 0])
| summarize People = sum(People) by Source
| order by case(Source == "Privileges", 1, 2) asc
content.title: Admins now, by where the rights came from

content.query:
let Sessions = AltiwardOCSF_CL
| where isnotempty(SessionUid)
| extend Ev = tostring(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.event_type)
| where Ev in ("elevation.granted", "admin.out_of_band", "elevation.revoked", "elevation.expired_enforced", "admin.out_of_band_removed")
| extend IsStart = Ev in ("elevation.granted", "admin.out_of_band"), Src = tostring(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.source),
    Exp = unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(tolong(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.expires_time)), Email = tostring(Ocsf.user.email_addr)
| summarize Started = minif(TimeGenerated, IsStart), Ended = maxif(TimeGenerated, not(IsStart)),
    Expires = maxif(Exp, Ev == "elevation.granted"), Src = take_anyif(Src, IsStart and isnotempty(Src)),
    Email = take_anyif(Email, isnotempty(Email)), UserName = take_anyif(UserName, isnotempty(UserName)),
    DeviceSerial = take_any(DeviceSerial) by SessionUid
| where isnotnull(Started)
| extend Source = case(Src == "privileges", "Privileges", Src == "out_of_band", "Without a grant", ""),
    Person = iff(isnotempty(Email), Email, strcat(UserName, " on ", DeviceSerial));
let PastExpiry = toscalar(Sessions | where isnull(Ended) and isnotnull(Expires) and Expires < now() | count);
let Open = (analytic: string) {
    AltiwardOCSF_CL
    | where ClassUid == 2004 and tostring(Ocsf.finding_info.analytic.name) startswith analytic
        and tostring(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.detail.state) != "detected"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, ActivityId) by Uid = tostring(Ocsf.finding_info.uid), DeviceSerial
    | where ActivityId == 1
};
let Failing = toscalar(Open("altiward.tamper.") | summarize dcount(DeviceSerial));
let Silent = toscalar(Open("altiward.agent_silent") | summarize dcount(DeviceSerial));
datatable(Alert: string, Order: int)["Rights past their expiry", 1, "Macs failing an integrity check", 2, "Macs not checking in", 3]
| extend Count = case(Order == 1, PastExpiry, Order == 2, Failing, Silent)
| order by Order asc
| project Alert, Count
content.title: Needs a look

content.json:
### Elevations
Sessions that started in the period. Extending rights doesn't count as a new elevation.

content.query:
let Sessions = AltiwardOCSF_CL
| where isnotempty(SessionUid)
| extend Ev = tostring(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.event_type)
| where Ev in ("elevation.granted", "admin.out_of_band", "elevation.revoked", "elevation.expired_enforced", "admin.out_of_band_removed")
| extend IsStart = Ev in ("elevation.granted", "admin.out_of_band"), Src = tostring(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.source),
    Exp = unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(tolong(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.expires_time)), Email = tostring(Ocsf.user.email_addr)
| summarize Started = minif(TimeGenerated, IsStart), Ended = maxif(TimeGenerated, not(IsStart)),
    Expires = maxif(Exp, Ev == "elevation.granted"), Src = take_anyif(Src, IsStart and isnotempty(Src)),
    Email = take_anyif(Email, isnotempty(Email)), UserName = take_anyif(UserName, isnotempty(UserName)),
    DeviceSerial = take_any(DeviceSerial) by SessionUid
| where isnotnull(Started)
| extend Source = case(Src == "privileges", "Privileges", Src == "out_of_band", "Without a grant", ""),
    Person = iff(isnotempty(Email), Email, strcat(UserName, " on ", DeviceSerial));
Sessions
| summarize Value = count()
| extend Metric = "Elevations", Order = 1
| union (Sessions | summarize Value = countif(Source == "Without a grant") | extend Metric = "Without a grant", Order = 2)
| order by Order asc
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Elevations in the period

content.query:
let Sessions = AltiwardOCSF_CL
| where isnotempty(SessionUid)
| extend Ev = tostring(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.event_type)
| where Ev in ("elevation.granted", "admin.out_of_band", "elevation.revoked", "elevation.expired_enforced", "admin.out_of_band_removed")
| extend IsStart = Ev in ("elevation.granted", "admin.out_of_band"), Src = tostring(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.source),
    Exp = unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(tolong(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.expires_time)), Email = tostring(Ocsf.user.email_addr)
| summarize Started = minif(TimeGenerated, IsStart), Ended = maxif(TimeGenerated, not(IsStart)),
    Expires = maxif(Exp, Ev == "elevation.granted"), Src = take_anyif(Src, IsStart and isnotempty(Src)),
    Email = take_anyif(Email, isnotempty(Email)), UserName = take_anyif(UserName, isnotempty(UserName)),
    DeviceSerial = take_any(DeviceSerial) by SessionUid
| where isnotnull(Started)
| extend Source = case(Src == "privileges", "Privileges", Src == "out_of_band", "Without a grant", ""),
    Person = iff(isnotempty(Email), Email, strcat(UserName, " on ", DeviceSerial));
Sessions
| where Source == "Privileges" and isnotnull(Ended) and isnotnull(Expires)
| extend HeldMin = (Ended - Started) / 1m, AllowedMin = (Expires - Started) / 1m
| summarize Elevations = count(), ["Median held (min)"] = round(percentile(HeldMin, 50), 1),
    ["Median allowed (min)"] = round(percentile(AllowedMin, 50), 1),
    ["Gave back early (%)"] = round(100.0 * countif(Ended <= Expires - 1m) / count(), 0) by Source
content.title: Time held against time allowed (median per elevation that ended)
content.noDataMessage: No elevations with an expiry ended in this period.

content.query:
AltiwardOCSF_CL
| where ClassUid == 2004 and ActivityId == 1
| summarize Findings = count(), Macs = dcount(DeviceSerial) by Finding = tostring(Ocsf.finding_info["title"]), Severity = tostring(Ocsf.severity)
| order by Findings desc
content.title: Findings raised in the period

content.query:
AltiwardOCSF_CL
| where ClassUid == 2004 and tostring(Ocsf.finding_info.analytic.name) startswith "altiward.tamper."
    and tostring(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.detail.state) != "detected"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, ActivityId, Check = tostring(Ocsf.finding_info["title"]), Severity = tostring(Ocsf.severity))
    by Uid = tostring(Ocsf.finding_info.uid), DeviceSerial
| where ActivityId == 1
| summarize Macs = dcount(DeviceSerial), Since = min(TimeGenerated) by Check, Severity
| order by Macs desc
content.title: Integrity checks failing now

content.query:
AltiwardOCSF_CL
| where isnotempty(DeviceSerial) and not(tostring(Ocsf.unmapped.altiward.event_type) startswith "console.")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Version = tostring(Ocsf.metadata.product.version)) by DeviceSerial
| summarize Macs = count() by Version
| order by Version desc
content.title: Agent versions (Macs that sent an event in the period)
content.noDataMessage: No Mac sent an event in this period.
